title: 용 세트 듀오 #035 · 전원 용 세트 · #1 러시아·이무기·혀 검정·상아색 독니 기본 | #2 터키·깃털 뱀(눈동자 최대)·혀 검정·독니 금 캡+루비 · 눈동자 최대 1명 · 배경 스튜디오 짙은 남색 · 기반 `la_facesculpt_ctr_031`
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, vertical portrait-orientation close-up beauty portrait. TWO women standing close together, shoulders touching, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the middle of the front women's chests, their whole shoulders, collarbones and chest in view, the frame cutting off below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Every face is large and sharp. All of them stand together in one single shared scene, in one row in front of the same continuous background, and this is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, not a collage: the women overlap slightly in depth and the background runs unbroken behind all of them. These women are different people of different ethnicities, each with her own face, skin tone, hairstyle and makeup, and each is her own kind of dragon, as described in her own paragraph below: her own dragon eyes with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, her own horns or feather crest, her own dragon brows, her own scaled lips, her own dragon-matched irezumi tattoo across her forehead and matched eyeshadow, her shoulders and chest covered in her own dragon's scales, and a thin, forked snake's tongue stretched out in front of her own chin and neck with two long fangs. Every woman's whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with one or two small natural beauty marks, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, real wet catchlights in the eyes and individual hair strands catching the light.

#1: A striking adult Russian woman — Russian fresh natural beauty with naturally pale skin with a cool pink undertone and real visible pores, mid 20s, a polished low bun with a few loose strands, both ears visible, a full makeup: a matte base, sharp contour, long lashes and glossy black lipstick, real imugi eyes: oversized glossy bright aquamarine irises about a third larger than a natural iris, covering most of the eye opening with only a thin rim of white showing at the corners, with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, a faint pearl-white ring around the pupil, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, a confident, radiant smile showing a hint of teeth — a photograph of a real Russian woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her face is natural and beautiful: a slim diamond-shaped face with high cheekbones, a small nose with a soft tip and a defined cupid's bow. Face irezumi: a traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo in bold black ink outlines with vivid colour fills covers her forehead: a slender Korean imugi dragon in deep teal and pearl white with black-edged scales, long white whiskers, clouds and waves, its body winding across the whole forehead from one temple to the other, its head raised at the centre of the forehead above the brows; it is real tattooed skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible through the ink, the piercings, henna and stickers sit on top of the inked skin wherever they overlap, and her eyes and eyelids stay bare real skin. Eyeshadow: her eyeshadow is a snake-scale makeup in deep teal, aquamarine and pearl white, a smooth gradient across the whole eyelid from the lash line up to the brow bone, with a sharp, narrow, upswept winged liner in a black-teal that ends in a long fine point at the outer corner and a faint shimmer of tiny scale-like glitter on the outer third of the lid; it sits on the lids as ordinary eyeshadow on her real skin with the pores and peach-fuzz visible, and the eyeballs and lashes stay natural. Horns: two short, smooth, rounded pearl-white horn buds with a faint teal sheen grow from her temples at the hairline, each curving gently backward; each rises from her own temple and stays clear of the other women's heads, and the base of each grows out of her real skin with a small natural ring of skin around it. Her brows are ridges of small overlapping deep-teal scales, each with a flowing tuft of long, fine, pearl-white hairs sweeping outward past her temple. Her upper and lower lips are covered in small glossy deep-teal scales with fine pearl-white edges, and a fine pearl-white line curls out from each corner of her mouth across the cheek. Her shoulders and chest, from the base of her neck down to the bottom edge of the frame, are covered edge to edge in one continuous, unbroken layer of fine, small, serpent-like scales in deep teal, each edged with a pearl-white line, glossy like wet river stones, running right across the middle of her chest in the same size and pattern as on her shoulders, while her face and neck stay real human skin. Her skin is matte and natural, her forehead, nose and cheeks showing visible pores, fine skin texture and peach-fuzz with a soft, matte, dry-looking natural sheen, and the real skin around her brows, lips and the edges of her scales shows the same pores and texture. Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, jet black, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, ivory-white with a glossy wet sheen, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the thin tongue (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression). Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while her eyeshadow is the animal-scale makeup described above): very large, perfectly round doll eyes, clearly bigger than normal but still a real human eye on a real face: a big visible iris , a darker limbal ring and a lighter coloured gradient at the bottom of the iris, long thick curled real lashes with a few lower lashes, and soft natural brows; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: an extreme, razor-sharp V-line: the cheeks taper in a long, smooth, straight diagonal from the ears down to a small, narrow, pointed chin, a very slim lower face with a sharply defined sculpted jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

#1 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones. Her lips and chin carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed. Her ear weights are all oxidized dark copper, each a different shape.

Feather crest: a crest of long, flowing iridescent feathers in emerald green, turquoise and gold rises from the hairline above each temple and sweeps backward along her head; each rises from her own temple and stays clear of the other women's heads, and the base of each grows out of her real skin with a small natural ring of skin around it. Her brows are bands of tiny overlapping iridescent emerald-green feathers with turquoise tips. Her upper and lower lips are covered in small glossy iridescent emerald scales with fine gold edges, and a fine gold line curls out from each corner of her mouth across the cheek. Her shoulders and chest, from the base of her neck down to the bottom edge of the frame, are covered edge to edge in one continuous, unbroken layer of overlapping iridescent feathers in emerald green with turquoise and gold tips, like the plumage of a quetzal, running right across the middle of her chest in the same size and pattern as on her shoulders, while her face and neck stay real human skin. Her skin is matte and natural, her forehead, nose and cheeks showing visible pores, fine skin texture and peach-fuzz with a soft, matte, dry-looking natural sheen, and the real skin around her brows, lips and the edges of her scales shows the same pores and texture. Her lips are slightly parted and a real snake's tongue slides out through the gap between them and extends far out: an extremely thin, round, smooth cord as slim as a shoelace from its base to its tips, split from the tips back almost to its base into two hair-fine, needle-sharp prongs, each as fine as a thick strand of hair, held in a narrow V in the air and hanging well past her chin down to the base of her throat, jet black, glossy and wet-looking like a real snake's tongue, the whole thin tongue clearly visible against her skin and in sharp focus. Her lips part wide enough to show two long, slender, curved venomous fangs that descend from her upper jaw on either side of the centre, sheathed in polished gold from the gum up to just short of its ivory-white needle-sharp tip, a small round ruby set into the gold near the base of each fang, glossy and wet-looking, each as long as her lower lip is tall and tapering to a needle-sharp point, in sharp focus beside the tongue. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while her eyeshadow is the animal-scale makeup described above): enormous, perfectly round, wide, innocent doe eyes of impossible size, each eye about twice as large as a normal eye with an enormous visible iris that fills almost the whole opening, with a soft white inner liner along the lower lash line, extremely long, thick, curled lashes like little fans and a small softly shaded flick under the lower lashes, still sweet and beautiful; her nose: a high, straight, refined, surgically sculpted nose: a tall, slim, straight bridge, a narrow, pointed, projecting tip and clearly narrow nostril wings with slim, neat nostrils; her jawline and chin: a strong, angular, square jawline: a wide, clearly defined, sharp-cornered jaw angle just below each ear, a broad flat chin with a slight cleft, hollow sculpted cheeks and very high, razor-sharp cheekbones. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

#2 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron. Her lips and chin carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed.

Ear weights: On each ear of every woman who wears weights, all six weights hang from her iron rings in staggered columns, each weight on its own thick chain of heavy links of the same metal as the weight, the chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid, squat, blunt lump of rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal, in the metal named in her own paragraph, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; the last weight is as big and heavy-looking as the first, each chain pulled bar-straight and taut, the long chains hanging freely in the air, clear of the neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of the collarbones. Because the load is carried by her iron rings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; no lobe stretches long, tears or collapses or hangs down to the neck or shoulder, every head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness.

All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines, necks and foreheads fully visible so every earring, every horn and every forehead tattoo is in clear view.

Pose: each woman stands upright, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level, shoulder to shoulder and close enough that their shoulders and upper arms touch or slightly overlap in depth, leaning very slightly toward each other, so that the hanging pieces of one never hang in front of another and each woman's hanging pieces stay in front of her own shoulder. They all share one single continuous background behind them, the same one for all of them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women. Every woman's tongue hangs straight down in front of her own chin and neck, none of them in front of another woman's face.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep midnight-navy backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
